description: Lists the document types Reciba can draft from a conversation (payment receipt, rent receipt, service quote and service order, for Brazil) and the fields of each one, with the type id that prepare_document takes. Reads nothing about the person. Tax invoices (nota fiscal) and health-service receipts for income tax are not available here. The declaração de residência, declaração de união estável and declaração de renda (a personal statement of income, not a tax return) and the recibo de salário are made by the person directly on reciba.com.br, not through this connector.
name: list_document_types

colunas.description: Só nas listas de itens: as colunas de cada item.

formato.description: texto, textolongo, moeda (reais), data (AAAA-MM-DD), mesano (AAAA-MM), telefone, escolha ou lista de itens.
